name: LOW_BRANCHES_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W5-SA74B (must be used with W8-SA64 PRUNING PLANNED; the sheet also shows the assembly with W8-17-1). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20).  Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): LOW 120 C, baseline -58 from the horizontal centre line (top 352), ink 252 (measured 251, centred); BRANCHES 120 C, baseline +112 from the horizontal centre line (top 522), ink 678 (measured 677, x 207-885).
